blocks.text: KABACAN, Cotabato – Classes in a school in Barangay Lower Paatan here were suspended following Wednesday’s attack that led to the killing of a village councilman and his brother. Lower Paatan Punong Barangay Abdulracid Dima ordered the temporary suspension of classes at Lower Paatan Elementary School, effective Wednesday, as a precaution for the safety of learners, teachers and school personnel. In his memorandum, Dima said classes would resume once authorities have assessed the situation and the safety of the school community “can be reasonably assured.” He also urged residents to stay vigilant, avoid the affected area and follow the instructions of […]...
